description: This source file implements serialization utility functions for string conversions, encoding/decoding (hex, base64), and related utilities within the WPEFramework project. It includes functions for converting between wide and narrow strings, encoding to hexadecimal and base64, and decoding from these formats, along with string escaping.

methods.description: Converts a narrow character string array to a std::wstring.

methods.name: void ToString(const char realString[],std::wstring & result)
methods.description: Converts a wide string array of specified length to a std::string.
